evidence.note: Returned 'client id provided is not registered'

evidence.claim: Discovery lists authorize and token endpoints, no registration endpoint

evidence.claim: Developer Console creates integration apps for demo client IDs and secrets
evidence.quote: you can now create integration apps to get demo client IDs and secrets for development and testing

evidence.claim: Public integration requires the Partner Program
evidence.quote: To launch a public integration, you must join the Docusign Partner Program.
You have a paid production account to manage the integration in production.
Manual reviews are typically completed within 24–48 hours.

evidence.claim: Token endpoint client auth is Basic with integration key and secret
evidence.quote: The Authorization header contains your integration key and secret key, concatenated by a colon character

evidence.claim: Access token lifetime is 8 hours by default
evidence.quote: Provides an access token with a lifetime of 8 hours, by default.

evidence.claim: Refresh returns a new refresh token; lifetime about 30 days, extended with the extended scope
evidence.quote: If you have obtained the extended scope, a new refresh token is issued with a full lifetime (typically 30 days).
You can optionally include a Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) challenge to add an additional layer of security.

evidence.claim: Secrets and redirect URIs are not copied at Go-Live
evidence.quote: Configuration settings such as secrets and redirect URIs are not copied automatically.

evidence.note: General knowledge of the DocuSign eSignature API, plus the scope used in the authorize probe.

requirements.detail: A free sandbox account is needed to create the integration key.
requirements.label: Docusign developer (demo) account

requirements.detail: Required to launch a public integration used by many Docusign customers.
requirements.label: Partner Program membership

requirements.detail: Needed to promote the integration key; you need admin or developer access to it.
requirements.label: Paid production account

requirements.detail: The token endpoint takes a Basic auth header: base64 of integration key and secret, with a form-encoded body.
requirements.label: Client authentication

requirements.detail: Access tokens last 8 hours by default for Authorization Code Grant.
requirements.label: Access token lifetime 8 hours

requirements.detail: Refresh tokens last about 30 days. A refresh returns a new refresh token. Without the extended scope it keeps the original expiry. With the extended scope it gets a full new lifetime.
requirements.label: Refresh token lifetime and rotation

requirements.detail: Public Authorization Code Grant uses code_challenge with S256 and the code_verifier.
requirements.label: PKCE for public clients

requirements.detail: Production uses account.docusign.com. Secrets and redirect URIs are not copied at Go-Live, so set them again.
requirements.label: Separate production host and config

scopes.note: Keeps refresh tokens renewing, so users stay connected without logging in again.

uncertainties.text: Authorization code lifetime was not stated on pages read.
Redirect URI matching rules (exact match, HTTPS, localhost) were not stated on pages read.
Rate limits were not stated on pages read.
Region-specific hosts (e.g. EU base URIs) were not covered. API base URIs come from userinfo.
Whether the Partner Program has its own approval wait, and its cost, is unknown.
Developer Console Go-Live is in open beta; the legacy flow may apply to your account.
The support FAQ page returned only navigation. The 'paid plan' point relies on the developer Go-Live page.
